name: Sticky Web Lurker Noose

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-18: The Fanciful March of Urwal

disable: DC 20 Survival check (trained) or DC 20 Thievery check (expert) to rearrange the webbing.

items.name: Web Noose
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps into the square with the web tripwire.

---

Effect The web lurker noose makes a noose Strike against the triggering creature.

text: Discreet webbing at throat level snags a creature that walks into it.
